name: Hiza no Ue no Partner ~Kitty on Your Lap~
original_name: ひざの上の同居人 ～Kitty on your lap～
source:
The game is a dating simulation that centers around the player winning over a female (feline) partner through the power of text. Visuals are displayed in a classic anime style with fully-animated scenes.

The player assumes the role of a college student who adopts one of three Cats who turns out to be a cat-girl. Hijinks ensue.

[from [url=https://www.giantbomb.com/hiza-no-ue-no-partner-kitty-on-your-lap/3030-37025/]Giant Bomb[/url]]
translation:
该游戏是一款约会模拟游戏，玩家通过文字的力量赢得女性（猫科动物）伴侣。视觉效果以经典动漫风格和全动画场景显示。

玩家扮演一名大学生，收养了三只猫中的一只，结果发现她是一个猫女孩。狂欢随之而来。

[来自[url=https://www.giantbomb.com/hiza-no-ue-no-partner-kitty-on-your-lap/3030-37025/]巨型炸弹[/url]]
